# Tanya's Sprint Retro

Tanya: "We shipped the async decision widget. Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter. The Zephyr integration was the key unlock."

The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

payload.rationale: This sprint retro echoes the prior Sprint 4 retro (Sample_Sprint4Retro_20260322) with the same three claims — async decision widget shipped, 23-point velocity, Zephyr integration as key unlock — so the passes need the full prior document and every position/observation it minted: Position_ZephyrIntegrationUnlock, Obs_TinaVelocity, Position_Sprint4ThesisProven, Obs_TanyaThesisProven, and StyleObs_Sprint4_MetricAnchor (which quotes the exact velocity line). I expanded both product narratives (Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning and Narrative_DecisionsEvaporate, plus Narrative_DecisionCaptureAtConsensus) because the retro's claims about async decision capture and shipping the widget bear directly on the thesis those narratives carry. I included the pricing positions (Position_PricingTwelveDollars, Position_PricingTier25Plus), the architecture decision (Position_WebhookArchitecture), the next-sprint focus (Position_ContextPreservationNextSprint), and the foundational positions (Position_AntiPatternRealtimeChat, Position_ProductCategoryAsyncPlatform, Position_TargetMarketRemoteTeams, Position_CoreFeatureDecisionCapture) so the passes can detect whether this later retro confirms, extends, or revises any of them. No areas were deliberately excluded — the graph is small and every node plausibly touched by this document was surfaced.
